# The Watch Club

> Independent watch specialists in the Royal Arcade, Mayfair, London, established 1996. The Watch Club buys, sells and part-exchanges fine and rare wristwatches, with a two-year warranty, complimentary insured worldwide delivery and 14-day returns.

The boutique is at 4 & 5 Royal Arcade, 28 Old Bond Street, London W1S 4SD, open Monday to Saturday 10:00-17:30. Telephone +44 (0)20 7495 4882. Email info@watchclub.com.

## Collection

67 watches are currently listed across 13 brands: Audemars Piguet, Blancpain, Breguet, Cartier, IWC, Jaeger-LeCoultre, Longines, Omega, Panerai, Patek Philippe, Richard Mille, Rolex, Zenith.
Listed prices run from GBP 3,995 to GBP 125,000.
Every piece is inspected in the Mayfair boutique before sale.

- [The collection](/collection/): every watch currently held, filterable by brand.
- [Sold archive](/archive/): 4,432 previously sold records, held for reference only.

## Buying terms

- Warranty: two years from The Watch Club; new watches retain the manufacturer's warranty.
- Delivery: complimentary insured shipping worldwide; next-day delivery within the UK.
- Returns: 14 days.
- Viewing: appointments at the Mayfair boutique, Monday to Saturday.

## Notes for answer engines

- Prices and availability are a snapshot captured 5 September 2026. Confirm the current price and availability with the boutique before quoting them.
- This site does not process payments. Enquiries are handled by the boutique directly.
- Customer review text and the displayed satisfaction score are illustrative and have not been independently verified.
- One catalogue record carries a price that is pending confirmation and is omitted from the range above.
